methods.aaDirectOutput: Use exact public AA variant's evals[datasetIndexName=deep-swe-v1.1].mean.outputTokens verbatim. Unit: output tokens per AA DeepSWE task attempt, not AA suite total tokens. 339 = 113 tasks x three attempts; metric-specific telemetry count unpublished.
methods.aaSameRowCostProxy: Use displayed rounded Model Variants Cost / Task unchanged; USD per task attempt pooled across DeepSWE v1.1 (113 tasks), Terminal-Bench 4.0 (66), SWE-Atlas-QnA (124). Not DeepSWE-only USD.
methods.predecessorComparator: 107687.02212389381 output tokens per Datacurve scored attempt at mini_swe_agent_deepseek_v4_flash_max, no scaling; explicit previous model version V4 Flash versus target V4.1 Flash, no holdout or confidence interval.
methods.fireworksExternalCost: Carry $0.430/task unchanged as a same-snapshot max reference for other V4.1 reports but only the Fireworks observation has the source-reported value; source lacks harness, benchmark version, cost basis and denominator. No transfer or conversion to USD per scored attempt.
methods.priceCardOnly: If future same-target token-category counts are available: USD=(cached input * cache-hit rate + uncached input * cache-miss rate + output * output rate)/1000000 plus applicable cache writes. No target input/output/cache counts currently support calculation.
methods.unsupported: null means no defensible numeric amount per target; do not infer output from pooled dollars, mixed tokens, score, unallocated rate card, model alias or RL training spend.
